title: Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Design
ai_core_responsibilities: Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and technology investment recommendations while leading cross-functional initiatives across a global organization. Engage directly with customers to validate opportunities and partner with engineering leaders to guide platform evolution and modernization.
ai_requirements_summary: Requires a bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline and significant experience in process automation or control systems. Candidates must demonstrate strong technical leadership, the ability to influence without authority, and expertise in industrial hardware and software architectures.
description_text:
About the role
We're looking for a senior Technical Product Manager who combines deep process automation expertise with strong technical leadership, customer focus, and business judgment.
You will work across customers, engineering teams, architects, cybersecurity specialists, and business leaders to identify the most important problems worth solving, shape product and technology investments, and drive execution across a global matrixed organization.
This role is for someone who takes ownership, challenges assumptions, influences without authority, and enjoys turning complex ideas into delivered outcomes.
What you'll do
Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and technology investment recommendations.
Engage directly with customers to understand problems, validate opportunities, and shape future offerings.
Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning software, firmware, hardware, systems, cybersecurity, networking, and cloud technologies.
Build alignment across globally distributed teams and drive issues to resolution.
Challenge requirements, estimates, architectures, and plans to improve outcomes.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations based on customer value, strategic alignment, technical risk, and business impact.
Partner with engineering leaders and architects to guide platform evolution and modernization.
Present recommendations and product strategy to customers, senior leadership, and industry audiences.
Required qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Significant experience in process automation, distributed control systems, industrial software, embedded systems, instrumentation, or control engineering.
Demonstrated technical leadership experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
Proven ability to influence technical and business decisions without direct authority.
Strong understanding of software, firmware, hardware, networking, cybersecurity, and systems architecture concepts.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Strongly preferred
Experience with Foxboro DCS, EcoStruxure Automation Expert, DeltaV, Honeywell Experion, ABB 800xA, Yokogawa CENTUM, Siemens PCS, or similar DCS platforms.
Experience in continuous process industries such as oil and gas, refining, chemicals, power generation, mining, or pulp and paper.
Background in instrumentation, process control, control strategy design, and plant operations.
Software and/or firmware development experience.
Experience delivering industrial hardware products.
Experience as a Lead Engineer, System Architect, Technical Lead, Automation Consultant, or Technical Product Manager.
Who will succeed in this role
The ideal candidate:
Takes ownership of difficult problems and drives them through resolution.
Thinks like an investor, treating engineering capacity as a limited resource.
Balances customer value, strategic importance, technical risk, and execution cost.
Is comfortable respectfully challenging assumptions and recommendations at any organizational level.
Earns credibility with software, firmware, hardware, systems, and cybersecurity teams.
Can confidently engage with customers, engineers, architects, Directors, and Vice Presidents.
Drives alignment quickly in ambiguous situations and across organizational boundaries.
Looks for platform leverage and reusable solutions rather than one-off implementations.
Why this role matters
You will help determine where we invest, what we build, and how our process automation platforms evolve. Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer success, technology direction, and long-term business growth.
Former Lead Controls Engineers, Systems Architects, Technical Leads, Principal Engineers, Automation Specialists, and experienced industrial Technical Product Managers are strongly encouraged to apply.
Bring your expertise to a team that values innovation and excellence — apply today!

title: Senior Industrial Design Engineer
ai_core_responsibilities: Lead industrial design and product engineering efforts for next-generation water treatment and dispensing systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate components and ensure designs are manufacturable, service-friendly, and market-ready.
ai_requirements_summary: Requires a bachelor's degree in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Candidates must have at least 7 years of relevant experience in product development and strong proficiency in CAD software like SolidWorks.
description_text:
Job Title: Senior Industrial Design Engineer
Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu – 635103
Company: Global Water Solutions (GWS)
Work Type: Full-time | 5 Days Work from Office
Reporting To: Global Compliance and Product Director
Availability: ASAP / 1 Month

About Us
Global Water Solutions (GWS) is a global leader in water enhancement and pressure tank solutions, delivering clean water technologies worldwide. As part of our continued expansion in India, we are strengthening our in-house engineering and product development capabilities to support next-generation water treatment, dispensing, and filtration systems.
This role is part of a strategic initiative to build strong internal industrial design and product engineering capability at our Hosur facility, enabling faster execution, improved product quality, and reduced dependency on limited external resources.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Industrial Design Engineer to lead product design and industrial engineering efforts for next-generation water treatment and dispensing systems. This is a hands-on individual contributor (IC) role focused on translating product concepts into practical, manufacturable, and market-ready designs.
The role will play a critical part in developing compact RO systems, UF systems, second-generation Q Tap systems, and product enclosures for multi-stage filtration platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong visual design sense with practical mechanical engineering expertise and is capable of driving designs from concept through production.

Key Responsibilities
Industrial Design & Product Development
Lead industrial design and product engineering for next-generation water treatment and dispensing products.
Design and improve product casings, external housings, coverings, and overall product layouts.
Develop solutions for compact RO systems, UF systems, Q Tap platforms, and multi-stage filter housings.
Balance aesthetics, functionality, cost, manufacturability, and serviceability in all designs.
Product Engineering & Integration
Collaborate with electrical and electronics teams to integrate PCBs, HMIs, pumps, valves, sensors, filters, and tubing into practical product assemblies.
Optimize product architecture for usability, serviceability, and assembly efficiency.
Ensure high-quality fit, finish, and overall product presentation.
Prototyping & Manufacturing
Support prototype development, design iterations, pilot builds, and production transfer.
Work closely with tooling vendors, suppliers, and factory teams to ensure design feasibility for mass production.
Apply strong DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) principles.
Execution & Capability Building
Improve internal product design standards and industrial execution quality.
Contribute to building scalable in-house product design capability in India.
Support multiple overlapping development programs with strong technical ownership.

Qualifications & Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Industrial Design, or related field.
Experience: Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in industrial design, product engineering, or mechanical product development.
Technical Skills
Strong CAD and product layout capability (SolidWorks or equivalent preferred).
Hands-on experience with product enclosures, plastic parts, sheet metal, and manufacturing processes.
Solid understanding of DFM, DFA, prototyping, and production release.
Experience designing electro-mechanical or appliance-type products.
Behavioral & Functional Skills
Ability to translate concepts into practical, manufacturable products.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across engineering, sourcing, and manufacturing teams.
Hands-on, execution-oriented mindset (not limited to design office work).
Ability to work independently and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Additional Qualifications
Experience in water treatment systems, filtration products, dispensers, pumps, or similar equipment.
Background in consumer appliances or durable electro-mechanical products.
Strong visual design judgment combined with engineering discipline.
Experience working with global teams and international product standards.

Expectations
Strengthen in-house industrial design and product engineering capability in India.
Accelerate development of next-generation products.
Deliver designs that are manufacturable, service-friendly, and commercially competitive.
Act as a key technical contributor across multiple product development programs.

Why Join Us?
Opportunity to shape the design and development of next-generation global products.
High ownership and visibility within a growing international organization.
Work across cross-functional teams including engineering, manufacturing, and global stakeholders.
Play a key role in building India’s product design capability.

What We Offer
Competitive salary package
Health insurance
International exposure
Performance-based annual bonus
Professional, supportive, and growth-oriented work environment

Join Our Team
If you are a hands-on industrial design engineer who enjoys turning concepts into real, manufacturable products and wants to build impactful global solutions, we encourage you to apply.
Website: www.globalwatersolutions.com

title: Sr. CAE Engineer
ai_core_responsibilities: The role involves supporting the improvement of fluid and thermal performance of products through CFD simulations. You will translate physical problems into numerical models and provide design solutions based on simulation results.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must hold an M.Tech degree in Mechanical, Automobile, or Aerospace Engineering. A minimum of 2-4 years of experience in CFD simulations and strong knowledge of engineering fundamentals are required.
description_text:
About Whirlpool Corporation
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2024, the company reported approximately $17 billion in annual sales - close to 90% of which were in the Americas - 44,000 employees, and 40 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com. 
About GTEC
Transforming Vision into Reality: The Global Technology & Engineering Centre. Where India’s world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation.
The team you will be a part of
The Engineering team discovers, develops and evaluates new product ideas, enhancements, or strategic product extensions, and translates research discoveries into usable and marketable products. Leads, plans and tracks all phases of the product life cycle, from inception to introduction into the marketplace. Coordinates with various functions to ensure successful product development and implementation.
This role in summary
Responsible for supporting in improvement of Fluid and Thermal performance of Products/Projects through CFD Simulations
Your responsibilities will include
Technical Expertise: 
Proficient in component/subsystem/system level Pre Processing tool (Ansys Workbench /CCM+/Spaceclaim /Creo etc )
Proficient in Flow simulation of component/subsystem level using any one of CFD tools (Fluent /Star CCM/Openfoam)
Proficient in Thermal simulation of component/subsystem level using any one of CFD tools (Fluent /Star CCM/Openfoam)
Required Technical Experience:
Should have Good knowledge of CFD fundamentals 
Should be able to prepare the simplified CAD models required. 
Define the mesh attributes and assign the required boundary conditions
Perform the CFD simulations, analyze the results, prepare proper reports with appropriate conclusions and suggestions to improve the product performance.
Hands on experience on flow and thermal problems.
Good knowledge of Engineering fundamentals of Thermodynamics, Fluid dynamics, and Heat transfer
Should be able to handle projects in the area of Fluid Flow and Heat transfer
Good Results interpretation skills.
Critical thinking for effectively approaching to conclusions
Minimum requirements
Education: 
M.tech from Mechanical/Automobile/Aerospace Engineering.
Experience: 2-4 Years 
Responsibilities:
Translate Simulation Requests, Physical Problems into Numerical Models.
Prepare the plan for simulation activities and align the simulation strategy with the requester
Execute CFD Simulation projects as an individual contributor
Establishing correlations and validations at Component/Subsystems Level
Good in problem solving
Have effective communication, aligned with the project requirement.
Provide design solutions based on simulations.
Preferred skills and experiences
KEY DELIVERABLES
Patents/ Research / External presentations :
Rigor to publish/present papers in Technical Forums
Technical rigor for patent filing and desirable to have patents
Knowledge Management :
Open in sharing knowledge and thoughts
Proactive knowledge documentation and sharing within and outside stakeholders
TECHNICAL
Knowledge of Fluid & Thermal Science .
Knowledge of CFD fundamentals 
Basic understanding flow and thermal Measurement Data
Proficiency in Simulation tools like Fluent/Star CCM/Openfoam
Results interpretation skills.
